_readme: Reference catalog: one row per game type, casinos pipe-delimited. Calculators key off game type, not room. Edges are unverified published/estimate figures, not transcribed BGC filings, unless noted. UTH spreads at HPC, Commerce, and Bicycle; Bad Beat Jackpot is Bicycle-only. Buster Blackjack is Bicycle-only; HPC and Commerce spread blackjack without it.

games.name: Baccarat
games.edge_text: ~1.123% of TTA when balanced (banker +1.235% vs Player action, +1.011% vs Banker action)
games.rules: 8-deck CA player-banked baccarat. Banker three-card 7 pushes the Banker line (even money, no commission) and is the Dragon 7 event. Player-dealer banks.
games.settlement_order: Player, Banker, Tie settle first; Panda 8, then Dragon 7, settle last.
games.notes: Base edge follows the closed-form baccarat math in CLAUDE.md. Fee schedules other than Bicycle are unfilled; gross-vs-net coverage (open question 1) is unconfirmed. Do not treat fee numbers as solved.

games.name: Baccarat (Hollywood Park)
games.edge_text: Same Player/Banker/Tie/Dragon/Panda as EZ. HPC short-pays 9/7 at 30:1 (44.1% house vs 8.1% at 50:1) and 9/1 at 100:1 (42.4% vs 13.9% at 150:1). 8/6 stays 25:1 / 21.8%.
games.rules: Hollywood Park EZ baccarat plus Golden Frog-style 9/7, 9/1, and 8/6. Player-dealer banks. 9/7 is a 2-card 9 beating a 2-card 7; 9/1 is a 3-card 9 beating a 3-card 1; 8/6 is any 8 beating any 6.
games.settlement_order: Player, Banker, Tie settle first; Panda 8, Dragon 7, 8/6, 9/7, 9/1 settle last.
games.notes: The 44% figure is 9/7 at 30:1 (Wizard p=0.018019). Standard Golden Frog pays 50:1 / 150:1 on 9/7 and 9/1. Felt payouts override.

games.name: Ultimate Texas Hold'em
games.edge_text: House edge ~2.185% of Ante (standard rules). Realized banker edge in the CA player-banked form depends on collection + player leak — VERIFY
games.rules: Ante + Blind + Play + optional Trips. Player raises 4x pre-flop, 2x on the flop, or 1x on the turn, else folds. Blind pays on a straight or better. Player-dealer banks all wagers. No Bad Beat Jackpot at Hollywood Park or Commerce.
games.settlement_order: Ante / Blind / Play settle first; Trips settles last.
games.notes: HPC and Commerce UTH has no BBJ. Standard published Ante edge; CA collection and leak are not transcribed.

games.name: Ultimate Texas Hold'em
games.edge_text: House edge ~2.185% of Ante (standard rules). Realized banker edge in the CA player-banked form depends on collection + player leak — VERIFY
games.rules: Ante + Blind + Play + optional Trips + Bad Beat. Player raises 4x pre-flop, 2x on the flop, or 1x on the turn, else folds. Blind pays on a straight or better. Player-dealer banks all wagers.
games.settlement_order: Ante / Blind / Play settle first; Trips, then Bad Beat Jackpot, settle last.
games.notes: Bicycle is the only room with Bad Beat. Standard published Ante edge; CA collection and leak are not transcribed. The BBJ edge is computed in the calculator from coverage, not this number.

games.name: Three Card Poker
games.edge_text: CA Face-Up: +4.30% of Ante (Wizard of Odds; one dealer card up, no Ante Bonus, must beat a non-qualifying dealer). Raise rate ~49.5%, so ~2.87% of TTA. Not a transcribed filing.
games.rules: California Face-Up Three Card Poker. Ante, then see three cards plus one dealer upcard; Play = Ante or fold. Dealer qualifies Queen-high. If the dealer does not qualify, the player must still beat the dealer to win the Ante (Play pushes). No Ante Bonus. Player-dealer banks.
games.settlement_order: Ante / Play settle first; Pair Plus, then 6 Card Bonus, settle last.
games.notes: Base edge is of the Ante, not TTA. Pair Plus and 6 Card Bonus edges are computed in the calculator from combinatorics + coverage. ρ ≈ 0.5 is an estimate (common dealer upcard).

games.name: Pai Gow Poker
games.edge_text: Banker edge ~1.27% of base when banking (banker wins copies; 5% commission on net wins). CA collection replaces commission and differs — VERIFY
games.rules: Seven cards set into a 5-card high hand and a 2-card low hand; both must beat the banker's to win. Banker wins copies. Joker is semi-wild (ace, or completes a straight/flush). Player-dealer banks.
games.settlement_order: Base settles first; Fortune / progressive side bets settle last.
games.notes: Base is near-even money, so exposure_mult ~1.0 — but Fortune Bonus tops at 8000:1, which is the real bank tail.

games.name: Blackjack
games.edge_text: ~1.5% estimate — not a solved figure. CA player-banked blackjack; no Buster.
games.rules: Player-banked blackjack. Player-dealer banks all wagers. Hollywood Park and Commerce do not spread Buster Blackjack.
games.settlement_order: Base (ante / bet / extra bet) settles first; any side bets last.
games.notes: HPC and Commerce blackjack, no BBJ. Edge is an estimate, not derived. ρ ≈ 0.5 is an estimate (common dealer hand).

games.name: No Bust Blackjack
games.edge_text: ~2.0% estimate spanning 1.5–2.5%. CA No Bust 21st Century Blackjack — not a solved figure.
games.rules: Player-banked No Bust 21st Century Blackjack: players cannot bust; the dealer can. Player-dealer banks all wagers. Mechanics per the GEGA-003955 filing.
games.settlement_order: Base (ante / bet / extra bet) settles first; Buster and other side bets settle last.
games.notes: Bicycle-only in this catalog, including Buster. Edge is an estimate range, not derived. ρ ≈ 0.5 is an estimate (common dealer hand).

games.name: Two Way Winner
games.edge_text: ~5% skill-leak estimate of booked Antes+Play — not solved. Route election (blackjack vs Hold'em) makes a closed form intractable; realized edge is leak-driven.
games.rules: Hollywood Park (GEGR-001574 / GEGA-004043). 53-card deck with a joker (2 or 12 in blackjack; ace/straight/flush in poker). Two equal Antes plus an optional Bonus. Player elects blackjack (Play = 1x Ante) or Hold'em (Play = 1x or 2x Ante), or surrenders one Ante back. On a blackjack win the unused poker Ante pushes. Player-dealer banks.
games.settlement_order: Antes / Play settle first; Bonus settles last.
games.notes: Base edge is a ~5% skill-leak estimate, not derived. Bonus is Fortune-style 7-card (Wizard counts, 9.90% to-1 on the 5000:1 cloth). Joker-22 beats 21 in blackjack; other 22s bust (floor report, not a filing).

sidebets.name: Main (Banker/Player/Tie)
sidebets.note: Base wager stored as a Sidebets row. CA EZ / 21st Century: Player 1:1, Banker 1:1 (Dragon 7 pushes Banker), Tie 8:1.

sidebets.name: Dragon 7
sidebets.note: Banker wins with a three-card 7. Pays 40:1. Edge is computed in the calculator from hand settlement, not this field.

sidebets.name: Panda 8
sidebets.note: Player wins with a three-card 8. Pays 25:1. Bicycle labels this Koi — same bet. Edge from hand settlement in the calculator.

sidebets.name: Main (Banker/Player/Tie)
sidebets.note: Same EZ main as the generic calculator. Tie 8:1.

sidebets.name: 9/7 44 HE
sidebets.note: 2-card 9 beats 2-card 7. Standard Golden Frog 50:1 is 8.10% house. HPC pays 30:1 — 44.14% house. This is the 44% figure.

sidebets.name: 9/1 44 HE
sidebets.note: 3-card 9 beats 3-card 1. Standard 150:1 is 13.87% house. HPC pays 100:1 — 42.39% house.
Any 8 beats any 6. 25:1, 21.79% house. Unchanged vs Golden Frog.

sidebets.name: Trips (Bonus)
sidebets.note: Pays on the player's final 5-card hand regardless of the dealer. Common schedule shown; house edge ~1.9–3.5% depending on the flush/straight lines — VERIFY.

sidebets.name: Trips (Bonus)
sidebets.note: Pays on the player's final 5-card hand regardless of the dealer. Common schedule shown; house edge ~1.9–3.5% depending on the flush/straight lines — VERIFY.

sidebets.name: Bad Beat Jackpot
sidebets.note: Bicycle-only. Pays on the losing hand when that loser is trips or better (Stones/M8trix rule). Straight flush 7,500:1; calculator computes realized edge from coverage. Confirm the PD covers this — VERIFY.

sidebets.name: Pair Plus
sidebets.note: Player's three cards, independent of the dealer. CA filed schedule (California Grand / BGC): Mini Royal 200, SF 40, trips 30, straight 6, flush 3, pair 1 (~4.38% house edge). Flush 4:1 is the 2.32% table — VERIFY the felt. Calculator uses exact 22,100-hand combinatorics + coverage.

sidebets.name: 6 Card Bonus
sidebets.note: Best 5-card hand from the player's 3 + dealer 3. BGC TCP-6B4 / Wizard 1-A: 1000/200/100/20/15/10/7 (~8.56% house edge). Not forfeited on a fold. Calculator uses C(52,6) counts + coverage. VERIFY the posted table.

sidebets.name: Bonus
sidebets.note: Optional 7-card joker bonus. Hollywood Park felt: 5000/750/250/100/50/20/5/4/3/2. Wizard combo counts. To-1 house 9.90%; for-1 on the same numbers is 29.09%. Felt prints to 1. No Envy.

sidebets.name: Fortune Bonus
sidebets.note: Rates the best 7-card hand. Wizard Fortune pay table 2 (8000/2000 RM/1000/400/150/50/25/5/4/3/2) is 7.77% to-1 before Envy. Calculator uses C(53,7) counts + coverage. Envy is extra PD liability — not in this number. VERIFY the felt.

sidebets.name: Buster Blackjack
sidebets.note: Bicycle-only. Pays when the dealer busts, scaled by cards in the busting hand. Common 9:1 / 5,000:1 is not this table — VERIFY the felt. Intermediate lines not captured.

paytables.outcome: Eight or more card dealer bust
